newsitem.title: USA: Sybron acquires Ivax chemical, garment units.
newsitem.headline: Sybron acquires Ivax chemical, garment units.

text.p: Sybron Chemicals Inc said on Wednesday that it had acquired the garment processing and textile chemicals segments of Ivax Industries, a subsidiary of IVAX Corp, for about $13.8 million in cash.
Sybron, an international producer of specialty chemicals, said revenues of the acquired businesses for the latest twelve-months period were in the range of $19 million.
In a statement, Sybron also said it expected the acquisition to be accretive to earnings in the first year.
"After a brief transitionary period, Sybron Chemicals will manufacture the products currently being produced by Ivax in Sybron's own facilities," Sybron said.
